before_conditions: A user has an existing order in the CLOB contract
The user calls the amend() function to modify that order's parameters
The amendment sets the order's limitOrderType to POST_ONLY
The amended price would result in an immediate match, even if only partial
required_property: A user should be able to amend an existing order to a price at which it would be filled, including crossing the spread to take liquidity, when that is the user's intention
bad_outcome: The amend() transaction reverts with PostOnlyOrderWouldFill(), so the user cannot amend the order to a fillable price
